description.value:
An old Cut that never sealed.

Gift — Your blood runs easy on purpose too: a fleshmancer harvesting Vitae from you (willingly) gets +1 from the draw. Tithe — The first persistent bleed you take each day has its flat check DC raised by 5.

cinderfall.incomplete: "A fleshmancer harvesting Vitae from you gets +1 from the draw" and "the first persistent bleed you take each day has its flat check DC raised by 5" both have no rule-element equivalent: Vitae is a Cinderfall-homebrew resource with no representation in the pf2e schema at all, and a persistent condition's flat-check DC is tracked per-instance on the condition, not adjustable via a generic actor rule (same gap as Regrower).
